attributes.action: Enforce change at local waste management sites on vehicle classification
attributes.additional_details: North Yorkshire council and hambleton council restrict visits to the waste management site in stokesley (and presumably others) to 12 visits a year if you have a commercial vehicle (understandable!) the government changes the classification of double cab pickup trucks as non-commercial. So the council should honour that at local waste management sites also!
attributes.background: I would like the government to enforce the ruling around double cab pickup trucks as non-commercial vehicles at local waste management sites as many still class them as commercial vehicles, limiting usage at the sites to 12 visits a year

rejection.details:
Decisions about access to waste management sites are a matter for your local authority, not the UK Government or Parliament.

You could raise this issue with a local councillor who represents you. You can use this page to find out who your local councillors are, and how to contact them: https://www.gov.uk/find-your-local-councillors

North Yorkshire Council has it's own e-petitions system. You can find out more here: https://www.northyorks.gov.uk/your-council/consultations-and-engagement/petitions/petitions-information-and-advice
